published.citation: Bonnefoy et al. (2018), A&A 618, A63, Appendix A: 6200 K, the BT-NextGen grid point that fits the star's spectral energy distribution and lies closest to the spectroscopic solution of D'Orazi et al. (2017); the range is one 50 K grid step either side, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.00657

temperature.note: Gaia DR3 publishes no sampled BP/RP spectrum of this bright star, so the colour is a Planck spectrum at the temperature its paper publishes; the range in the prepared report is the colour at the lower and upper bounds.
